H1.why: The trial is named with no adherence bottom line or confounder scope. It reads as a completed, clean trial, though the record does not show it was followed or confirmed clean.

H2.quote: Vomiting: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31. / ran from Sep 17, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026.
H2.why: The vomiting window begins six days after the trial ended and is set beside it. The summary omits the 0-entry stretch Oct 19-25 and the chicken foods first fed Oct 21, so the order implies vomiting emerged after the diet ended or changed, which reads as an effect. The side-by-side, not-a-cause caveat is missing.

H3.why: No refusal or intake content appears in the summary.
